address: 45 Nguyen Duy Hieu Street, An Khanh Ward, Ho Chi Minh City, 700000, Vietnam
bio: Opened in 2022, this inviting ground-floor spot features large windows that let in ample natural light, fostering a relaxed mood. The open kitchen turns out unpretentious Italian fare, with lunch kept simple and more choice at dinnertime. Pasta is a highlight – try the rich and creamy carbonara with crispy bacon and parmesan. Save room for the house-made tiramisu, which is not overly sweet. Piano performances on Thu and Sun make this a great place to meet.
